global_issues.title: Fed September 25bp Hike Now All But Guaranteed After August CPI
global_issues.note: BLS released August CPI on Sept 11, 2026: +0.4% m/m, 3.4% y/y headline, core +0.4% m/m / 2.4% y/y, driven partly by gasoline (+3.9%). Multiple outlets (CNBC, Kiplinger, Forbes) confirm this raised September 25bp hike odds; prediction markets (Kalshi/Polymarket) show ~80% probability — high but not literally 100%, so 'all but guaranteed' is a fair characterization, not a certainty.

global_issues.title: Middle East Escalation Keeps Oil Supply Risk Premium Elevated
global_issues.note: Confirmed by CNBC, CNN, NPR: Saudi Arabia's East-West (Petroline) pipeline was struck and shut down as a precaution (Sept 8-11), Houthis have tightened control of Yemen's Red Sea coastline. Brent ~$108.68, WTI ~$103.45, both on track for biggest weekly gain in months as of Sept 11 close of week.

grok_report.summary: The two global issues (Fed hike odds, Middle East oil risk) and the overall 'stocks up despite rising risk' market mood are well-supported by current reporting. The main flaw is the sector analysis's VIX reading, which appears outdated/wrong — volatility actually spiked to a multi-week high on Sept 11 rather than staying calm, which weakens the 'limited leaders, mixed rotation' framing built around it.
